quote: The sun is a wondrous body. Like a magnificent father! If only I could be so grossly incandescent!
author: Solaire of Astora

quote: Don't get yourself killed neither. Neither of us want to see you go Hollow.
author: Andre of Astora

quote: Good bye then. Be safe, friend. Don't you dare go Hollow.
author: Laurentius of the Great Swamp

quote: My name is Lucatiel. I beg of you, remember my name. For I may not myself, but... a little while.
author: Lucatiel of Mirrah

quote: There is no path. Beyond the scope of light, beyond the reach of Dark... what could possibly await us? And yet, we seek it, insatiably.
author: Aldia, Scholar of the First Sin

quote: A lie will remain a lie.
author: Aldia, Scholar of the First Sin

quote: Seek strength. The rest will follow.
author: King Vendrick

quote: I may be small, but I will die a colossus.
author: Ludleth of Courland

quote: Ashen One, hearest thou my voice, still?
author: The Fire Keeper

quote: Still closed... Still closed... Mmm... No use making a song and dance about it. I have to use my head and think.
author: Siegmeyer of Catarina

quote: Thou who art Undead, art chosen... In thine exodus from the Undead Asylum, makest pilgrimage to the land of Ancient Lords.
author: Oscar of Astora

quote: Yes, indeed. It is called Lothric, where the transitory lands of the Lords of Cinder converge.
author: Narrator

quote: Praise the Sun!
author: Solaire of Astora

quote: Our Lord and Liege. I prithee play the usurper. Wrest the fire from its mantle.
author: Yuria of Londor

quote: Humans are such fascinating creatures. Quite incapable of giving up, aren't they?
author: Karla

quote: Every fleeting man must one day succumb to the dark.
author: Sir Vilhelm

quote: Fear not the dark, my friend, and let the feast begin.
author: Locust Preacher

quote: To be alive... to walk this earth... That's the real curse right there.
author: Crestfallen Saulden

quote: Let the flames guide thee.
author: Fire Keeper

quote: Even in the deepest darkness, a single ember may kindle a roaring fire.
author: Ashen One Lore
